description: Create a SimplifyQA sprint under an existing release and return its key (SP-xx). Needs `releaseId` (id, code like RE-44, or exact name — create the release first with release_create), `name`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `estimatedEffort` (hours). The state defaults to New and the owner to the connected user. A sprint with the same name in that release is refused; dates outside the release's are warned about. It reads the sprint back. Only an admin user can create sprints.

owners.description: Owners: emails, names, user ids or "me". Default: the connected user (SimplifyQA requires at least one owner).

plannedEndDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

releaseId.description: The release this sprint belongs to: id, code (RE-44) or exact name.

state.description: Defaults to the project's first state (New). An unknown state is refused with the valid ones listed.

name: sprint_create
title: Create a sprint under a release (SimplifyQA)
